title: Glycine is a competitive antagonist of the TNF receptor mediating the expression of inflammatory cytokines in 3T3-L1 adipocytes.
authors: Romero-Nava, Rodrigo; Alarcon-Aguilar, Francisco J; Giacoman-Martinez, Abraham; Blancas-Flores, Gerardo; Aguayo-Ceron, Karla A; Ballinas-Verdugo, Martha A; Sanchez-Munoz, Fausto; Huang, Fengyang; Villafana-Rauda, Santiago; Almanza-Perez, Julio C
journal: Inflammation research : official journal of the European Histamine Research Society ... [et al.]
one_liner_zh: 该文研究甘氨酸作为TNF受体拮抗剂抑制脂肪细胞炎症因子表达，涉及分子对接但对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To determine the involvement of TNF-alpha and glycine receptors in the inhibition of pro-inflammatory adipokines in 3T3-L1 cells. METHODS: RT-PCR evidenced glycine receptors in 3T3-L1 adipocytes. 3T3-L1 cells were transfected with siRNA for the glycine (Glrb) and TNF1a (Tnfrsf1a) receptors and confirmed by confocal microscopy. Transfected cells were treated with glycine (10 mM). The expressions of TNF-alpha and IL-6 mRNA were measured by qRT-PCR, while concentrations were quantified by ELISA. RESULTS: Glycine decreased the expression and concentration of TNF-alpha and IL-6; this effect did not occur in the absence of TNF-alpha receptor due to siRNA. In contrast, glycine produced only slight changes in the expression of TNF-alpha and IL-6 in the absence of the glycine receptor due to siRNA. A docking analysis confirmed the possibility of binding glycine to the TNF-alpha1a receptor. CONCLUSION: These findings support the idea that glycine could partially inhibit the binding of TNF-alpha to its receptor and provide clues about the mechanisms by which glycine inhibits the secretion of pro-inflammatory adipokines in adipocytes through the TNF-alpha receptor.
abstract_zh: 目的：确定TNF-α和甘氨酸受体在3T3-L1细胞中抑制促炎性脂肪因子中的作用。方法：通过RT-PCR证实3T3-L1脂肪细胞中存在甘氨酸受体。将3T3-L1细胞用针对甘氨酸（Glrb）和TNF1a（Tnfrsf1a）受体的siRNA转染，并通过共聚焦显微镜确认。转染后的细胞用甘氨酸（10 mM）处理。通过qRT-PCR测量TNF-α和IL-6 mRNA的表达，而浓度通过ELISA定量。结果：甘氨酸降低了TNF-α和IL-6的表达及浓度；在缺乏TNF-α受体（由于siRNA）的情况下，此效应未发生。相反，在缺乏甘氨酸受体（由于siRNA）的情况下，甘氨酸仅对TNF-α和IL-6的表达产生轻微变化。对接分析证实了甘氨酸与TNF-α1a受体结合的可能性。结论：这些发现支持甘氨酸可能部分抑制TNF-α与其受体的结合，并为甘氨酸通过TNF-α受体抑制脂肪细胞中促炎性脂肪因子分泌的机制提供了线索。
